newsitem.title: USA: Carson buys Cutex line from Chesebrough.
newsitem.headline: Carson buys Cutex line from Chesebrough.

text.p: Carson Inc said on Monday it acquired the Cutex nail-care product line from Chesebrough-Pond's USA Co for exclusive use in the United States and Puerto Rico, in a deal valued at $41 million.
Specific terms were not provided. Chesebrough-Pond's is a unit of Unilever Group.
At the same time Carson said it refinanced its $40 million senior debt facility, replacing it with a new $100 million facility.
Carson said the total Cutex product line generated about $27.5 million in net sales in 1996, equal to about a third of Carson's 1996 calendar revenues.
Carson makes hair-care products. Its shares opened at 8-1/4 on Monday, up 1/8.
